extracted.intended_audience: recipients and subrecipients of Federal awards (including States), pass-through entities, and grant financial administrators
extracted.subtask_description: Requirements for recipient and subrecipient financial management systems and records to ensure proper expenditure, reporting, and accountability of Federal awards. Covers identification, reporting, documentation, internal controls, budget comparison, and written procedures for cash management and cost allowability.

rubrics_metrics.name: State compliance with State laws and procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Each State must expend and account for the Federal award in accordance with State laws and procedures for expending and accounting for the State's funds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: States must follow their own statutory and procedural requirements when expending and accounting for Federal awards while still meeting Federal reporting and tracking obligations. See related provisions such as §200.450 for cost documentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sufficiency of financial management systems for reporting and tracking
rubrics_metrics.description: All recipient and subrecipient financial management systems, including records documenting compliance with Federal statutes, regulations, and the terms and conditions of the Federal award, must be sufficient to permit the preparation of reports required by the terms and conditions; and tracking expenditures to establish that funds have been used in accordance with Federal statutes, regulations, and the terms and conditions of the Federal award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Financial systems and records must enable timely preparation of required reports and demonstrate that expenditures align with federal requirements and award terms. Systems should document compliance and support audits and monitoring.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identification of Federal awards and programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Identification of all Federal awards received and expended and the Federal programs under which they were received.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Federal program and Federal award identification must include, as applicable, the Assistance Listings title and number, Federal award identification number, year the Federal award was issued, and name of the Federal agency or pass-through entity. This information ensures traceability of funds to specific awards and programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accurate, current, and complete financial disclosure and reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Accurate, current, and complete disclosure of the financial results of each Federal award or program in accordance with the reporting requirements in §§200.328 and 200.329.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recipients must produce financial reports that are timely and reflect the true financial status of each award per §§200.328 (financial reporting) and 200.329 (financial reporting by recipients). When a Federal agency requires accrual-based reporting from an entity that keeps non-accrual records, the entity is not required to implement an accrual accounting system but may develop accrual data for reports based on analysis of existing documentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Records identifying amounts, sources, and expenditures
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintaining records that sufficiently identify the amount, source, and expenditure of Federal funds for Federal awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Records must contain information necessary to identify Federal awards, authorizations, financial obligations, unobligated balances, as well as assets, expenditures, income, and interest. All records must be supported by source documentation to substantiate charges and balances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effective control and accountability for funds, property, and assets
rubrics_metrics.description: Effective control over and accountability for all funds, property, and assets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The recipient or subrecipient must safeguard all assets and ensure they are used solely for authorized purposes. Implement internal controls and custody procedures; see §200.303 for additional related requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comparison of expenditures with budget amounts
rubrics_metrics.description: Comparison of expenditures with budget amounts for each Federal award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Financial management must include routine reconciliation or comparison of actual expenditures to the approved budget for each award to detect variances and support budget management and compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Written procedures to implement cash management requirements (§200.305)
rubrics_metrics.description: Written procedures to implement the requirements of §200.305.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recipients and subrecipients must document procedures for cash management (timing of drawdowns, cash advances, interest, return of funds, etc.) as required by §200.305 to ensure proper handling of Federal funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Written procedures for determining cost allowability
rubrics_metrics.description: Written procedures for determining the allowability of costs in accordance with subpart E and the terms and conditions of the Federal award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Establish documented processes to evaluate whether costs are allowable, allocable, and reasonable under the Cost Principles (subpart E) and any specific award terms. Procedures should guide consistent application and support auditability.
